title: Prediction: Box Math
prompt:
A challenge in two parts.

PART 1 — fix the sizing: the `.box` in the boilerplate has width: 200px but renders 248px wide. Add the universal border-box rule at the top of the stylesheet so width means what it says. Keep the .box rule exactly as it is.

PART 2 — space it out: give `.box` a margin of `1rem` on all sides.
boilerplate: 200 means 200

tests.name: universal border-box applied
tests.hint: The universal selector (*) with box-sizing: border-box is the first rule of every stylesheet.

tests.name: box rule unchanged
tests.hint: The point is that border-box changes the *interpretation* of width — the rule itself stays.

tests.name: margin all sides
tests.hint: margin: 1rem; — one value applies to all four sides.
